description: Uses the configured AI assistant to review one appointment ask from a sales call in context. Returns prose with a verdict, present and missing parts, a tailored rewrite in the rep's voice, and one coaching line. Choose this for phrasing and coaching; use check_appointment_ask for deterministic six-part scoring and a fixed template example. Available only when an assistant provider is configured.
name: review_appointment_ask
title: Review an appointment ask
